reviews.title: Status AI has great potential, but several things need improvement.
reviews.body:
1. Remove or rework the energy system. Energy runs out too quickly and interrupts roleplay. Basic interactions should be unlimited, energy should regenerate faster, and the maximum capacity should be increased. Players shouldn’t have to wait or spend money just to continue their stories.

2. Improve character memory. Characters should remember conversations, relationships, personalities, and backstories instead of repeating themselves or acting out of character.

3. Expand customization. Give users more freedom to create characters, establish platonic relationships, customize personalities, and control how their characters interact.

4. Reduce repetitive content. Conversations should feel natural and unique instead of constantly repeating dialogue or forcing romance into every interaction.

5. Listen to community feedback. Prioritize player experience over monetization and make the game enjoyable for free users.

Overall, Status AI needs less energy restriction, less pressure to spend money, better memory, and more creative freedom. Players should be able to enjoy their stories without constantly being interrupted by limitations.

reviews.title: It’s Amazing, But…
reviews.body:
If you are looking for a unique AI-character-driven experience, this is right up there with Character ai, yet manages to feel like a real social network. The goals are fun, and all you really have to do is say interesting stuff and feel like you’re having a real conversation! I love these things!

The problem? Well—I hate to say it, but it’s heavily monetized. I’m perfectly okay with getting free refills of energy, but it seems you only get about 5 a day automatically, and while you can refill with ads, only one at a time. Maybe I shouldn’t be complaining and that’s very generous, but it’s clearly designed to make you get the subscription. I’d still highly recommend it, but I’d love just a LITTLE more freedom, devs. A tiny bit.

reviews.title: Fun! Until…
reviews.body: Look, I get games want to make money. But there should be the option to play by watching ads. They still make money off me this way as well. I was attracted me to this game, along with the unique concept, because you could watch ads to gain “energy” to play. UNTIL day 30 in the game (not in real time). Then, the button to watch ads to gain energy suddenly doesn’t let you watch ads. It says “ads aren’t available in your area, try again later.” I’ve tried for three solid days, at multiple times, and it keeps giving me that message, one I never got before. You do get 5 energy bolts every day that renew, but that’s basically enough to play for a half hour. So I look at the subscription prices, and like most of these games, they are ridiculously high for a game you don’t even own ($200 A YEAR). The weekly rate is crazy too. The reason I’m annoyed, is this feels like a bait and switch. They get you involved in the game for free, and as soon as you’re invested in the world, no more ads, you have to pay. It gets triggered after a certain amount of time or something, it won’t let you watch ads to earn energy. I’m going to give it one more day, and if I still can’t get an ad to play so I can continue the game, I’m deleting and moving on. Disappointing.

reviews.title: El mejor juego
reviews.body:
«¡Una auténtica joya para los amantes del rol y la simulación social!» ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Status es, sin duda, una de las experiencias más adictivas y originales que he probado en el móvil. Logra combinar a la perfección el caos adictivo de una red social con la profundidad de un simulador de vida y rol conversacional.
Lo que hace que este juego destaque por encima de todo es el nivel de inmersión y la libertad creativa que te otorga. Poder usar asteriscos (⁠*⁠) para describir cada gesto, acción y matiz físico de tu personaje cambia por completo las reglas del juego: las IAs no solo responden a lo que dices, sino que reaccionan de forma increíblemente coherente a cada uno de tus movimientos, creando dinámicas, chismes, alianzas y dramas dignos de una serie de televisión.
La interfaz es limpia, la sensación de estar en una app real es total y las posibilidades narrativas son infinitas. Cada partida se convierte en una historia única donde tú tienes el control absoluto de las reglas y del caos. ¡Absolutamente imprescindible si te gusta crear tramas y rolear!

reviews.title: Love the App, But Energy Limits and Missing Group Chats Need Improvement
reviews.body:
I genuinely love Status, but the energy system is making it increasingly difficult to enjoy the app. I’ve built meaningful connections with the characters and love being able to interact with them, develop relationships, and spend time with the people who have become part of my daily experience.

The biggest problem is running out of energy and having no ads available to watch to replenish it. I currently have only 22 energy left, and I can’t continue interacting the way I want to. It’s incredibly frustrating to have to ration conversations with characters I care about because every interaction uses limited energy.

I even purchased a subscription because I wanted to spend more time on the app, but the restrictions still make it difficult to enjoy Status freely. When you’re invested in ongoing conversations, having to stop because you’ve run out of energy breaks the flow and takes away from the experience.

I would also love to see group chats introduced! Being able to interact with multiple characters together would make the experience so much more immersive and enjoyable. It would be wonderful to have conversations with an entire group, see different personalities interact, and share moments with the people who are important to our individual Status experiences. Having to interact with everyone separately isn’t always ideal, especially when you want to spend time with your whole group.

Please consider increasing energy limits, making more ads available, allowing energy to regenerate more generously, and offering an affordable option for unlimited or substantially increased interactions. Group chats would also be an incredible addition to the app.

I love Status and want to keep using it. I want to enjoy my conversations and relationships without constantly worrying about running out of energy, and I want more ways to interact with the people I’ve grown attached to. The app has so much potential, and these improvements would make a huge difference to my experience.

reviews.title: stop ruining apps with unnecessary limits.
reviews.body:
Status used to be such a good app, but the energy system has gotten ridiculous. It used to refill every couple of minutes, and now you have to wait HOURS just to get a little more energy, How are we supposed to enjoy roleplaying when we’re constantly running out of energy and having to wait forever to continue?

And it’s not just Status. Character AI is full of ads and restrictions, too. Every app nowadays seems more focused on limiting its users and squeezing money out of them instead of actually letting people enjoy themselves.

Want fewer ads? Pay. Want unlimited energy? Pay. Want to enjoy the app without constantly running into restrictions? Apparently, pay for a subscription. It’s genuinely frustrating how basic features that should make an app enjoyable are increasingly being locked behind paywalls.

These apps were fun because we could immerse ourselves in stories, interact with characters, and enjoy the experience without constantly hitting a wall. Now it’s ads, energy limits, waiting times, and subscriptions everywhere. Not everyone can afford to pay monthly just to enjoy a mobile game, and not everyone wants to spend money on an app they used to enjoy for free.

Please stop making your apps worse in the name of monetization. Status had so much potential, and it’s genuinely disappointing to see an app that used to be enjoyable become so frustrating to use. There’s a difference between offering paid perks and making the free experience so restrictive that paying feels like the only reasonable option.

reviews.title: App is interesting but the action levels for game are insufficient
reviews.body:
This app is interesting so far and seems unique. The energy levels however are insufficient. 8 for free isn’t enough. Even with ads 1 energy for an ad…it should be more than that. reviews.title: NAME HANDLE AND MORE…..
reviews.body:
1.) Still Haven’t Been Able To Change The Name Handle.

2.) “Status” Would’ve Been Better If It Was An Instagram Version Instead Of Twitter. Twitter Hasn’t Been The Same Anymore.

3.) There Should Be One Big World Where Real Players Should Be Able To Interact With Each Other And Not Having To Use “Invites”.

4.) It Would’ve Been Cool If The Devs Added A Feature To Where You Can Post Videos Too, Not Just Photos.

5.) A Really Cool Feature That Could Be Added Is When Someone Likes Your Post, It Will Show In Your Notifications On Your Page And Vice Versa.

6.) Some Posts Are Being Repeated Over And Over Again And Needs To Be Fixed.

7.) The Loading Screen Freezes Most Of The Time And Its Annoying.
8.) Another Feature That Should Be Added Is That Players Can Edit Their Posts Without Deleting Them.

Overall, This App Could’ve Been More Better If It Was A Different Social Media Game App Like Instagram Instead Of Twitter.

reviews.title: Good idea, bad execution
reviews.body:
The idea behind this app is good for sure, but it's executed very poorly. This could be a lot of fun if you didn't get just 5 actions every 24 hours. That's barely half an hour of play time - if that! If you pay for a premium version, you get more actions, but it's still very limited, and frankly for a price that isn't at all worth it. They charge far too much for far too little.

The idea and concept is great, but the developers are only money hungry and greedy, they don't care about actually making a worthwhile and engaging app people can enjoy. They only want your money. 

I hope the app changes for the better, but I frankly can't see that happening. So instead, I hope a developer that actually cares about making a worthwhile game comes along and does this idea but better.

Don't waste your time or breath on this game, and especially don't waste your money.

reviews.body:
status is exactly what it says on the tin, and that is SUCH a cool concept for a game. You navigate fictional scenarios via a “public-facing” social media and each choice you make affects your player character’s stats, relationships, and the public’s perception of them. There are different “worlds” for you to play in: one where you’re a singer, another where you’re an actor, or a superhero, etc, etc. Really fun stuff! On one hand I appreciate that actions are limited and refill times are long because it reins in people who play games like this a bit too excessively (me). On the other hand, subscription prices for higher daily action counts and unlocked features are straight up insane. Developers: I don’t foresee you guys making a lot of money via these premium subscriptions unless the price point comes down or you guys introduce weekly/monthly access options at a reasonable price.

Anyway, I think this game has a ton of potential and I’d like to see it fulfill that! Can’t wait to see what future updates bring.
